packageRules.description: Deny by default. config:recommended ships managers of its own, so opt in explicitly instead, and a preset change can never widen scope on its own.
Go modules and the go directive in go.mod, which CI's setup-go reads through go-version-file.
Indirect requirements are go mod tidy's to move, and the rule above would otherwise re-enable them over the gomod manager's own default.
Actions are pinned to a commit SHA with the tag in a trailing comment; Renovate bumps both.
